overall: Actual account talent bonuses summarized before campaign/dungeon departure. Saved and paused battles display departure-time levels separately. Existing purchases/start/resume/admission and all original battle rules retained. Godot3559/Python12/157GUI/19OSrestore PASS;physical mobile/final art/audio/economy approval separate.

implementation.formatter: New stateless AccountBonusSummary reads original AccountTalents validation, CHAINS/IDS/DEFINITIONS, effect_text and bonuses functions. No preview RunState, duplicate bonus formula, purchase/fileIO/settlement/RNG/timer or new saved field.
implementation.preparation: Existing campaign/dungeon preparation shows actual owned total/54, three category briefs and an expandable list of active original effects. Fully upgraded account shows all18, cumulative final15% rather than adding5+10+15. Original units and temporary-value labels retained. Actual final combat effects also depend on base stats, battle upgrades and original caps.
implementation.saved_battle: Lobby resume and pause show validated saved/current battle account_talent_levels at departure. Current account and old battle are explicitly distinguished. Later account purchases do not retroactively change saved HP/MP or bonuses; original new-start/Continue perform all state transitions.
implementation.errors_and_controls: Unreadable account or invalid saved levels are unavailable, never fake zero. Existing launch/back and dungeon admission error stay above expandable information. Toggle uses existing ticket/menu revision and current block lookup; stale deferred callbacks cannot modify a new menu. Inspection is read-only.
implementation.preservation: 71other production/data/assets files including entire Main/RunState/progression/save/audio/guard unchanged;11Mobile gameplay/start/purchase/admission/resume method bodies byte-identical. SingleRunState/save15/7RNG/6min3min/daily2/economy/HP/XP/spawns/MP40/4+4/art unchanged.

static_integrity.scope: UTF-8, delimiters, whitespace, JSON/Python syntax, resource existence, project settings; NOT GDScript parser/typechecking or gameplay.

growth_data_contract.scope: JSON schema/content and source integration markers only; not GDScript runtime/behavior.

magic_data_contract.scope: JSON validation, negative data controls and source markers/arithmetic; NOT GDScript runtime, UI, input dispatch or mobile tests.

feedback_source_contract.scope: 7 affected code/test/checker files: UTF-8, delimiters, whitespace, Python syntax, reaction constants, integration markers, engine-test registration and new dependency paths only. NOT the full project check or GDScript parser/type/runtime, rendering, or mobile input tests.

mobile_hud_source_contract.scope: Changed UTF-8 files, delimiters, Python syntax and integration source checks only. NOT GDScript parsing/typechecking, actual Control geometry, touch dispatch, rendering or mobile execution.

run_navigation_source_contract.scope: UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax and navigation SOURCE contracts only; NOT GDScript parsing/types, native execution, actual UI/input, or mobile testing.

combat_cues_source_contract.scope: Changed-source UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax, hook order, bounds, isolation, reviewed GAME-024 RunState/GAME-030 view baselines with exact GAME-033 read-only adapters and preserved engine runner. NOT Godot parser/type/runtime, visual quality, input dispatch, or FPS.

godot_runtime.scope: headless import, actual foundation/growth/magic/feedback/mobile-HUD/run-navigation/combat-cues GDScript tests and main boot; visual/mobile approval separate

source_proof.ownership: Entire Main/RunState/Cues/View/GoldProgress/progression/storage/data/assets/audio/guard unchanged. Only mobile summary UI/control ordering and new static table-based formatting change production.

gui.scope: Actual account purchases/preparation/summary inspection/native newstart and saved-Continue,none/partial/full/error/dungeon plus inherited game/result regression. Funds,resource/clock/crowd placements are explicit QA,not natural balance/income/physical-phone proof.
